query:
-- Plantes sans QID avec nom latin disponible (priorité haute)
SELECT id, name, latin_name, category 
FROM plants 
WHERE (wikidata_qid IS NULL OR wikidata_qid = '')
  AND latin_name IS NOT NULL AND latin_name != ''
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 20;
